eps.d: There's a buzz of activity in Studio 7 at the BBC TV Centre as Sarah Greene and Phillip Schofield go live ... Special guests Going Live are pop stars Living in a Box. If you're curious about your cat, expert Grace McHattie is bringing in her Ragdoll this morning. She'll have lots of feline facts at her fingertips, so why not Ask the Expert?

Wiuth Sarah Greene and Phillip Schofield. This morning's live band is The Christians with their latest single When The Fingers Point. Wildlife expert Jessica Holm reports from a country show featuring a host of rare and unusual animals. Revealing some of the secrets of Queen Victoria's personal life through her diaries is handwriting expert Diane Simpson.

Sarah Greene and Phillip Schofield and the Going Live! gang invite you to switch on to Studio 7 and meet their guests, snooker stars Steve Davis and Dennis Taylor. If you wear glasses, fashion expert Annabel Giles has some great ideas for you to try out next time you need a new pair. There's the first of the Newsround Newshound stories.

Sarah Greene and Phillip Schofield open the doors of Studio 7 to bring you another action-packed show. This morning's live music is from Terence Trent D'Arby. Author and conservationist Gerald Durrell has a fantastic journey to tell you about - and you could win a safari holiday in Kenya .

Sarah Greene and Phillip Schofield and the Going Live! gang invite you to join them and the Studio 7 guests for another Saturday morning's entertainment. To start off, why does a band from Shrewsbury have the same name as the vulcan Princess from Star Trek? If you don't know, phone T'Pau this morning and ask them.

Sarah Greene and Phillip Schofield open the doors of Studio 7 to bring you another action-packed show. There's music from this morning's live band and you can phone them on [number removed]. It's mayhem with Peter Simon when he hosts another crazy edition of Double Dare. Mark Chase has his special report and Simon Hickson and Trevor Neal are around to 'help'. Join the Going Live!

Sarah Greene and Phillip Schofield open the doors of Studio 7 to bring you another action-packed show. There's music from Donny Osmond and a special canine report on a dog's-eye-view of vet Nigel Taylor 's day. Peter Simon has another gunge-filled edition of Double Dare and Simon Hickson and Trevor Neal are around too. Join the Going Live!

Sarah Greene, Phillip Schofield and the Going Live! gang open the doors of Studio 7 to bring you another action-packed show. Special guest this morning Sylvester McCoy reveals the secrets of Doctor Who. Those very odd-jobbers Simon Hickson and Trevor Neal are around too. So are Spiderman and His Amazing Friends in another exciting cartoon adventure.

Sarah Greene and Phillip Schofield have another fun-filled morning lined up for you. Can you design a cover for an LP record? If so, Johnny Hates Jazz would like your help. Watch this morning for more details. There's music, too, from Shakin' Stevens. Comedian Phil Cool is calling into the studio; so is Annabel Giles, who has some fashionable ideas to help you decorate your school folders.

Sarah Greene and Phillip Schofield and the Going Live! gang present an action-packed programme. Special guests in Studio 7 include Michael Crawford, the star of Phantom of the Opera, Gilly Coman, who plays the outrageous Aveline in Bread, and the chart-busting Wet, Wet, Wet. Garden enthusiasts can pick up some really interesting ideas from green-fingered guest Richard Jackson.

Sarah Greene and Phillip Schofield and the Going Live! gang open the doors of Studio 7. 'Angie' from EastEnders is calling in. Agony uncle Phillip Hodson is on hand with useful advice on personal problems. Top pop group ABC are around as well. There's Peter Simon and Double Dare, Video Vote and Spiderman, Simon Hickson and Trevor Neal too.

Sarah Greene and Phillip Schofield have a great line-up of entertainment 'going live' for you this morning. Singing star Tom Jones is calling in. So is this week's special Press Conference guest Esther Rantzen. The St Philip Choir performs Sing Forever, their hit from the Children in Need appeal. Astronomer Heather Couper has news of the appearance of Comet Bradfield.

Sarah Greene and Phillip Schofield host a special programme that's just packed to bursting point with Christmas goodies. Musical guests this morning include Curiosity Killed the Cat and Pet Shop Boys. Pantomime dame Christopher Biggins is making a special appearance, so too are the London Community Gospel Choir with a song for Christmas.
Join the Going Live! gang for a very special Boxing Day programme. There are star guests, live music, competitions, treasure hunts, pen pals, jokes, video voters, and cartoons too.

Sarah Greene and Phillip Schofield have a special New Year entertainment lined up for you: music, videos, competitions, features, Double Dare, cartoons and loads more. They've got something for everyone this morning.

Sarah Greene, Phillip Schofield and the Going Live! gang open the doors of Studio 7 to this morning's guests, including Terence Trent D'Arby and his latest video, Phillip Hodson with advice on personal problems and pantomime star Tudor Davies and his friend, Mrs Robinson Crusoe. There's cartoon action with Thunderbirds 2086 and another great edition of Double Dare with Peter Simon

Sarah Greene and Phillip Schofield and the Going Live! gang present an action-packed morning from Studio 7. There's cartoon adventure with Thunderbirds 2086. Peter Simon is falling over himself to present another edition of Double Dare. Simon and Trevor delve into the Bottomless Bin to bring you monsters galore, while Gordon the Gopher is hoping to be this week's special guest on the video vote.

Sarah Greene, Phillip Schofield and the Going Live! gang have a great line-up of Saturday morning entertainment. There's music from Debbie Gibson singing live in the studio. Tim Furniss has a round-up of what should be happening in space in 1988. Special Press Conference guest is business tycoon and adventurer Richard Branson.

Sarah Greene and Phillip Schofield have a great line-up of entertainment for you this morning. There are star guests to phone and competitions to enter. Why not try for the Treasure Hunt this week? There's the Video Vote, too. Will you agree with this morning's panellists? If you like cartoons then you won't want to miss the latest adventure with Thunderbirds 2086.

With Sarah Greene and Phillip Schofield This is it! The countdown has begun to find the BBC Young Entertainer of the Year! From thousands of acts, 24 finalists have been selected. In this first heat, four acts are ready to perform for you.

It's all happening in Studio 7 this morning! Sarah Greene Phillip Schofield and the Going Live! gang have the second heat in the BBC Young Entertainer of the Year competition. Another four acts are waiting to see if they get your vote. Agony uncle Phillip Hodson answers some of your 'growing pains' letters. Photographer Russ Malkin has some easy tips on how to take better pictures.

Sarah Greene, Phillip Schofield and the Going Live! gang have heat three in the BBC Young Entertainer competition lined up. Voting for your favourite act could win you a prize! The Press Conference guest is 'the man who bought the company', businessman Victor Kiam. He might have some hints on how to make it big! Looking for a foreign pen pal? There's a very special pen pal service for you today.

There's a special film profile of show-jumping brothers Philip and Mark Heffer. You can also find out how Trevor and Simon got on when they visited a big London toy fair.
